description: This file contains implementation of various lifecycle state handlers for a plugin in the WPEFramework, including methods for handling state transitions such as loading, initializing, pausing, resuming, suspending, hibernating, and terminating. It interacts with runtime and window manager handlers, manages application context, and uses Boost UUIDs for generating unique IDs.

classes.name: UnloadedState
classes.description: Handles the unloaded state of the application lifecycle.

classes.name: LoadingState
classes.description: Handles the loading state, generating a new application instance ID.

classes.name: InitializingState
classes.description: Handles the initialization process, starting the runtime manager.

classes.name: PausedState
classes.description: Handles the paused state, managing display and runtime suspension.

classes.name: ActiveState
classes.description: Handles the active state, ensuring render readiness.

classes.name: SuspendedState
classes.description: Handles the suspended state, managing display and runtime suspension/wake.

classes.name: HibernatedState
classes.description: Handles the hibernated state, hibernating the runtime.

classes.name: TerminatingState
classes.description: Handles termination, killing or terminating the application.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the transition to the respective state, performing necessary actions.
